content:
Hi! I have just made my first PRs to CSLib, so I wanted to say hello and share a bit here.

I have already been contributing to Mathlib for a while, and I'm currently studying type theory in more depth as part of my masters thesis. I'd like to contribute something in that direction eventually, so I started by reading what the library already has. Today I was studying the file Languages/LambdaCalculus/LocallyNameless/Context.lean and opened two PRs:

  • CSLib #918: first I found the file had a couple of little style things that could be fixed (unused variables, missing spaces...)
  • CSLib #919: after that, I was thinking that the definition mapVal and lemmas about it must definitely already be proved for List.map. I found this was true so I propose some refactor of these plus some additional lemmas.

Would appreciate feedback on this as they are my first contributions! I have read the guides and I hope I'm doing things the right way. Looking forward to contribute more :)
These sound very reasonable, I'll take a look when I get a chance.
